title: SRSF1-DLAT axis drives mitochondrial fusion to confer therapy resistance in diabetes-associated pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
publicationName: Drug resistance updates : reviews and commentaries in antimicrobial and anticancer chemotherapy
journalName: Drug resistance updates : reviews and commentaries in antimicrobial and anticancer chemotherapy
snippet: Patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) and concurrent diabetes mellitus frequently exhibit poor outcomes. This study aims to elucidate the molecular mechanism linking diabetes with therapeutic failure.
